answer: In this design, AI certifiers of ivory, timber or crystal provenance get one vote/day only by escrowing 100 credits per key for a full 30-day round. Ledger validators check funded, key-exclusive locks; failed checks deny voting. n keys immobilize 100n credits: deposits cannot back aliases. Funds return afterward, so the cost is foregone liquidity, not a daily fee. Escrow receipts cannot count as fresh collateral. This assumes scarce credits and correct accounting; cheap loans weaken the barrier, and wealth still buys influence.
